commands: Get-Command R, Rterm, Rscript -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Source | Format-List; where.exe Rterm 2>$null; where.exe Rscript 2>$null; where.exe R 2>$null

Get-Process -Id 39056,11672 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, HasExited | Format-List; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ParentProcessId=39056 OR ProcessId=39056" | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-List

$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", 47822)
$stream = $client.GetStream()
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream)
$writer.AutoFlush = $true
$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)
$writer.WriteLine("x <- 7")
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
while ($true) {
  $line = $reader.ReadLine()
  if ($null -eq $line -or $line -eq "__END__") { break }
  [void]$sb.AppendLine($line)
}
$client.Close()
Write-Output "FIRST_CALL_RESULT<<"
Write-Output $sb.ToString()
Write-Output ">>"

$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", 47822)
$stream = $client.GetStream()
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream)
$writer.AutoFlush = $true
$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)
$writer.WriteLine("x * 6")
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
while ($true) {
  $line = $reader.ReadLine()
  if ($null -eq $line -or $line -eq "__END__") { break }
  [void]$sb.AppendLine($line)
}
$client.Close()
Write-Output "SECOND_CALL_RESULT<<"
Write-Output $sb.ToString()
Write-Output ">>"

$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", 47822)
$stream = $client.GetStream()
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream)
$writer.AutoFlush = $true
$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)
$writer.WriteLine("__SHUTDOWN__")
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
while ($true) {
  $line = $reader.ReadLine()
  if ($null -eq $line -or $line -eq "__END__") { break }
  [void]$sb.AppendLine($line)
}
$client.Close()
Write-Output "SHUTDOWN_RESULT<<"
Write-Output $sb.ToString()
Write-Output ">>"
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
Write-Output "STILL_ALIVE<<"
Get-Process -Id 13368,17588 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName | Format-Table | Out-String
Write-Output ">>"
notes: Kept one Rterm process (pid 13368) and sent two separate calls into it. The first call ran x <- 7. The later call ran x * 6 in that same process and printed [1] 42. An earlier bridge (host pid 11672, R pid 39056) crashed before evaluating and exited on its own. Then quit pid 13368 cleanly (exit 0); host pid 17588 exited after that. Did not use Rscript or arf, did not attach to a session I had not started, and did not kill any process. commands lists the shell commands through directory creation. Later shell commands only serialized this transcript.
